decisions.reason: The battery-runtime goal does not change the specified electrical protection controller, thresholds, resistors, or protection functions.
The source establishes an efficiency goal for the system power path but does not change the NTC interface or thermal-protection behavior.
Maximizing battery runtime does not alter the independent requirement for effective heat transfer through the AXP2101 exposed pad.
The efficiency goal does not resolve or modify the battery connector family, pitch, pin count, functions, part number, or unresolved pin order.
The source does not change the charge-status display method, external LED circuit, connector, or component population requirements.
The battery-efficiency objective does not change the panel-mounted button interface or its PWRON control behavior.
The switchable boost rail already has its own explicit off-by-default and periodic-use behavior; the source adds no new control, load, current, or usage requirement.
The general battery-runtime goal does not change DCDC1 voltage programming, current rating, load coverage, or rail-compensation behavior.
Battery efficiency may motivate monitoring, but the source does not change the monitor device, measured rails, placement, coverage, or channel count.
The battery-runtime goal has no entailed effect on the power board's four-layer stack.
The source concerns battery-powered operation and does not modify the separate USB-only standalone supply, source selection, or unresolved regulator-current question.
The battery-efficiency objective does not change connector placement, orientation, accessibility, or mounting-hole clearance.
